text:
After an eventful day, we welcome your clear note, and we are sorry that your companion animal travel experience with Aurelia Skyways did not reflect the care and order you were promised. Your complaint states that the animal was handled poorly during transit, that the support offered at arrival was not sufficient, and that you are seeking review and correction from the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

We have recorded the matter in the desk ledger and have begun a careful review of the boarding notes, the transfer record, and the welfare report made by the staff on duty. The purpose of this review is to confirm where the service fell short, whether the care plan was followed as written, and what follow-up is required to support your claim. <<FACT F120>> Please keep any supporting material available, since clear records help us complete the review with accuracy and fairness.

The animal's comfort and safety remain our first concern, and our records aide will ensure that the observations from the welcome team and the transit staff are compared with the traveler report. If the review shows a service failure, we will proceed under the applicable care provisions and document the outcome in plain terms. <<FACT F113>> Please understand that every report is handled with care, and every recorded change is checked against the original instructions for the journey.

We regret the distress this incident caused and will continue to treat your concern with the seriousness it deserves. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will remain available to receive the remaining papers and complete the record review promptly.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
